title: Jiang Yanggu | Planeswalker
description: Learn about the Planeswalker Jiang Yanggu, and his loyal hound Mowu, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: He can’t remember his name, his past, his family—or if he even has a family. He decided to call himself Yanggu, meaning “the valley where sun rises,” after the first place he can remember: the Easternmost Valley. He travels alongside the Planeswalker Mu Yanling and his loyal hound, Mowu, searching for his past memories.
